bio.text: Michael Whatley is the Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in North Carolina in 2026.
He chaired the North Carolina Republican Party from 2019 through 2024 and the Republican National Committee from March 2024 to August 2025.
According to The Assembly, he studied history at UNC Charlotte, earned a master's degree in religion at Wake Forest University, and received a joint degree in law and theology from Notre Dame.
The Assembly also reports he served as a deputy assistant secretary in the U.S. Department of Energy and that Sen. Elizabeth Dole named him her chief of staff in 2004.
